mapper.select:
select id, xiangmu_bianhao as xiangmuBianhao, xiangmu_mingcheng as xiangmuMingcheng, jiage, zhixing_zhouqi as zhixingZhouqi, zhixing_cishu as zhixingCishu, danwei, zhuangtai, miaoshu from huli_xiangmu
zhuangtai != '已删除'
and xiangmu_mingcheng like concat('%', #{xiangmuMingcheng}, '%')
and zhuangtai = #{zhuangtai}
order by id desc

select x.id, x.xiangmu_bianhao as xiangmuBianhao, x.xiangmu_mingcheng as xiangmuMingcheng, x.jiage, x.zhixing_zhouqi as zhixingZhouqi, x.zhixing_cishu as zhixingCishu, x.danwei, x.zhuangtai, x.miaoshu from jibie_xiangmu jx join huli_xiangmu x on jx.xiangmu_id = x.id where jx.jibie_id = #{jibieId} and x.zhuangtai != '已删除' order by x.id desc

select x.id, x.xiangmu_bianhao as xiangmuBianhao, x.xiangmu_mingcheng as xiangmuMingcheng, x.jiage, x.zhixing_zhouqi as zhixingZhouqi, x.zhixing_cishu as zhixingCishu, x.danwei, x.zhuangtai, x.miaoshu from huli_xiangmu x where x.zhuangtai = '启用' and not exists ( select 1 from jibie_xiangmu jx where jx.jibie_id = #{jibieId} and jx.xiangmu_id = x.id ) order by x.id desc
mapper.update: update huli_xiangmu set xiangmu_bianhao = #{xiangmuBianhao}, xiangmu_mingcheng = #{xiangmuMingcheng}, jiage = #{jiage}, zhixing_zhouqi = #{zhixingZhouqi}, zhixing_cishu = #{zhixingCishu}, danwei = #{danwei}, zhuangtai = #{zhuangtai}, miaoshu = #{miaoshu} where id = #{id}
update huli_xiangmu set zhuangtai = #{zhuangtai} where id = #{id}
update huli_xiangmu set zhuangtai = '已删除' where id = #{id}
